definitions.explanation: A player positioned in the middle of the field, linking defense and attack in soccer and other sports.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はMFとして{司令塔|しれいとう}の{役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たしている。
examples.english: He serves as the playmaker in the midfielder role.

examples.japanese: {攻守|こうしゅ}に{貢献|こうけん}できるMFが{欲|ほ}しい。
examples.english: We want a midfielder who can contribute to both offense and defense.

notes:
MF stands for Midfielder. It is the standard abbreviation for the midfield position in soccer.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {攻撃的|こうげきてき}MF: attacking midfielder
- {守備的|しゅびてき}MF: defensive midfielder
- ボランチ: defensive midfield (from Portuguese)
- トップ{下|した}: attacking midfield position
- {司令塔|しれいとう}: playmaker

ALTERNATIVE TERMS:
- ミッドフィルダー: midfielder (full word)
- {中盤|ちゅうばん}: midfield
- ハーフ: half (older term)

SOCCER POSITIONS:
- GK: goalkeeper
- DF: defender
- MF: midfielder
- FW: forward
